title: Council seat opinion
description: The one contract every council seat's answer must validate against. Written flat, with no $ref and no $defs: the same file is handed verbatim to codex --output-schema and grok --json-schema, whose $ref support is unverified, so inline nesting is the only shape all three enforcement paths are known to share. Strict-engine rule: every object lists every property in required; optional strings are nullable unions with minLength 1 so an empty string can never masquerade as absent. Length bounds follow one rule: the smallest power of two at or above three times the longest value observed in live consults.

schema.description: Contract tag. A document without it is not an opinion, whatever else it contains.

position.description: The seat's stance in prose: what it would do and why.

findings.description: Falsifiable claims, each carrying its evidence citations. An empty array is a seat that found nothing, which is itself an answer.

id.description: Finding id, unique within this opinion.

claim.description: One sentence that could be shown to be false.

citations.description: Evidence ids that must resolve inside the evidence pack.

check.description: A concrete command or falsification test the orchestrator can run; null when the seat offers none.

fix.description: What the seat would change, offered as a claim rather than a directive; null when the seat offers none.

answers.description: Answers to the questions the brief asked directly.

keep_list.description: Invariants that must not change, which the orchestrator checks the diff against.

assumptions.description: What the seat had to assume because the evidence pack did not settle it.

confidence.description: Informative only. Synthesis weighs evidence, not confidence.
